curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the age-and-license rule, define residency by example, then the thirty-day licensing deadline, who is exempt, and the thirty-day change-of-name-or-address rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card separating the thirty-day deadlines from the ninety-day residency example.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the deadline lengths and the exempt groups.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what the written test covers and when offices stop giving it, then what passing earns and who may supervise a permit driver.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for test scope, the closing-time cutoff, the permit and the supervisor rule; contrast cards for the age lines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on test timing and permit supervision.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through who gives drive tests, the vehicle check, who may ride along, the retake wait, examiner conduct, and what the test scores.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card that ties the next-business-day wait to the drive test only.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what is allowed before and during the drive test.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach lane selection and lane management, where a turn starts and finishes, then the signal distances and the cancel rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each graded behavior; contrast cards for right versus left turn start points and urban versus highway signal distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on turn position and signal distances.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover smooth speed control, a correct stop and stopping gap, smooth acceleration, and the searching habits that driver aids never replace.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per graded skill; a contrast card for driver-assist aids versus physical searching.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on stop position, following gap and scanning.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the minor path: the Affidavit of Liability and its signer, the twelve-month permit hold, the driving log, and the behind-the-wheel training rule with its substitute.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each requirement; contrast cards for night hours inside the total and the training substitute.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on minor requirements and who they apply to.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show how passenger limits step up over the first year, then the midnight-to-five curfew and its exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per stage and the curfew; contrast cards for each passenger step.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a teen driver and asking what is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the main grounds for suspension or revocation, then the crash-related grounds and the other listed grounds.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per group of grounds; a contrast card showing crash conduct counts too.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described act can cost a license.

one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
